entities.name: Sandworm
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage and sabotage group also tracked as UAC-0002 and APT44.

entities.name: UAC-0133
entities.gloss: A threat group and sub-cluster of Sandworm targeting Ukrainian critical infrastructure.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: QUEUESEED
entities.gloss: A C++ backdoor malware family also known as KAPEKA, KNUCKLETOUCH, ICYWELL, and WRONGSENS.

entities.name: LOADGRIP
entities.gloss: A C-based ELF injector malware that executes payloads using the ptrace API.

entities.name: BIASBOAT
entities.gloss: A C-based ELF backdoor that acts as a Linux variant of QUEUESEED.

entities.name: GOSSIPFLOW
entities.gloss: A Go-based malware providing tunneling via Yamux and SOCKS5 proxy capabilities.

entities.name: WEEVELY
entities.gloss: A PHP webshell tool used for post-exploitation and remote control.

entities.name: REGEORG.NEO
entities.gloss: A web shell and tunneling tool used to proxy traffic into corporate networks.

entities.name: PIVOTNACCI
entities.gloss: A PHP-based tunneling tool used for pivoting within compromised networks.

entities.name: SDELETE
entities.gloss: A command-line utility for securely deleting files, abused for destructive purposes.

entities.name: CHISEL
entities.gloss: A fast TCP/UDP tunnel transported over HTTP and secured via SSH.

entities.name: LIBPROCESSHIDER
entities.gloss: A Linux library hook tool used to hide processes under Linux via LD_PRELOAD.

entities.name: JUICYPOTATONG
entities.gloss: A local privilege escalation tool for Windows.

entities.name: ROTTENPOTATONG
entities.gloss: A local privilege escalation tool for Windows systems.
